usedFor: Eventzilla holds registrations, and Google Drive stores a file through “Copy a File” after each “New Registration”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each registration can get a copy of a file in a selected folder, with a new name.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file to a shareable link, so keep registrant files away from it.
